title: How a Lagos manufacturer reset its tax posture before FIRS engagement
summary: Partner-led tax review, intercompany documentation and authority-ready positions.
challenge: Incomplete transfer pricing files and an open FIRS review created contingent liability, board anxiety and unpredictable cash calls.
approach: 90-day tax diagnostic, reconstruction of intercompany policies, monthly provisioning discipline and structured dialogue with authorities.
outcome: Leadership gained documented positions, reduced penalty exposure and a repeatable tax calendar the CFO owns.

title: How a multi-branch retailer gained weekly visibility on margin and cash
summary: Finance operating model, outsourced management accounts and KPI packs for the CEO.
challenge: Branch data arrived late and inconsistently—decisions on pricing, stock and promotions were effectively blind.
approach: Process redesign, standardized branch templates, outsourced close support and executive dashboards.
outcome: Monthly reporting stabilized with branch-level margin insight and a 13-week cash view for leadership.

title: How a Nigerian fintech passed investor diligence with confidence
summary: Virtual CFO, model rebuild and data room preparation for a growth round.
challenge: Diligence flagged weak controls, optimistic forecasts and gaps in the financial narrative.
approach: Controls roadmap, model re-base, governance pack and transaction advisory through data room Q&A.
outcome: Investor-ready materials, clearer board governance and completion of the diligence phase.
